title: nz-active: 2 smaller precision and sourcing points
description: 'The only agency saying so' needs a precise qualifier: Note (and agencies.json) say NCSC NZ is the only agency saying so. True for 'active exploitation', but CERT.LV, a national CERT, says automated exploitation attempts were already detected in Latvia (21 Oct, 23:00 local). Say 'the only agency to report active exploitation; CERT.LV reports attempts'. | Cannot tell whether the sentence was in the 9:15am original or the 10:20am update: The capture (08:17Z, 22 Oct) shows the page after its 10:20am NZDT update; only the platforms paragraph is marked as updated, so the sentence is probably original, but one capture cannot show it.
